descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: MUST load FIRST, before any action, for any task that mentions a desklamp or floorlamp, or says 'look at', 'examine', 'inspect' or 'find' an object 'under'/'in'/'with' a lamp. Take the object, go to the lamp, use it.
descriptions.pick_and_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, for every basic 'put a X in/on Y' or 'put some X on/in Y' task with one object (e.g. 'put a mug on the desk', 'put some soap in the cabinet'). Load whenever the task has no clean/hot/cool/heat/wash/warm/cold word, no lamp, and no 'two'. Find, take, place.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, whenever the task says 'clean', 'wash', 'rinse' or 'cleaned' (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet', 'clean X and put it in Y'). Take the object, clean it at the sinkbasin, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, whenever the task says 'cool', 'cold', 'chilled', 'chill' or 'refrigerate' (e.g. 'put a cool apple on the table', 'cool X and put it in Y'). Take the object, cool it with the fridge, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, whenever the task says 'hot', 'heat', 'heated', 'warm' or 'cook' (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop', 'heat X and put it in Y'). Take the object, heat it in the microwave, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, whenever the task has 'two' of something, a plural object, or a count of 2 (e.g. 'put two pillows on the sofa', 'find two cds and put them in the drawer', 'put two soapbars in the cabinet'). Find and place two objects of the same kind, one at a time.
